_instructions: 40 questions across AMZN, MSFT and GOOGL, one run. Each question has a ticker: run_eval.py --ticker X asks only that company's questions; eval_companies.py runs all three.

Graded on tool choice (all 40), citations (every answer) and correctness by the AI judge (every question with an expected answer, plus the ones the agent should decline). Price and watchlist questions (tool_only) have no fixed answer, so only their tool choice is graded.
expected_tools: sec = filing search, technical = BigQuery signals table, watchlist = watchlist tool, [] = no tool.
Expected answers come from the filing ingest_filings.py stored for each company (see 'filings'). When a company files a new 10-Q or 10-K, update its answers.

AMZN.note: answers copied from eval_questions_AMZN_tools50.json; check against the stored filing
